intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Jacksonville, FL, in English or Spanish
paragraphs: Latin Remodeling Llc is a Latino-owned remodeling company doing bathroom remodeling in Jacksonville, FL. Our photos show what we like to build: walk-in showers with big marble-look porcelain panels, matte black rain heads and handhelds, and a shower wall with a column of iridescent blue glass hexagons set between marble and brushed gold fixtures.

Customers tell us the experience matters as much as the result. One says our team was professional and fast, the prices were very reasonable, and being able to talk with us in Spanish made everything so much easier for his family. A more recent client summed it up in a few words: perfect, and just in time.

items.name: Bathroom and shower remodels
items.blurb: We build clean, open walk-in showers that make a bathroom feel bigger. This one uses large white marble-look porcelain from floor to ceiling, a square matte black rain head, a black handheld on a hose and matching black door hardware.

image.alt: Marble-look porcelain shower with a matte black rain head, wall valve and handheld shower beside a white curtain

items.name: Tile showers with accent walls
items.blurb: A single accent strip can make a shower feel custom. Here a column of iridescent blue glass hexagon tile runs up a white marble wall, framed by a brushed gold rain head, valve and slide-bar handheld. We help you pick the accent and plan where it goes.

image.alt: Iridescent blue glass hexagon tile column set into white marble shower walls with brushed gold rain head and handheld shower

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens get the same attention as baths. A kitchen update can include new shaker cabinets, fresh counters, a tile backsplash, flooring and paint. Tell us how you cook and what is not working in the room today, and we will put together an estimate.

about.text: Latin Remodeling Llc is a Latino-owned remodeling company in Jacksonville, FL. We build walk-in tile showers and remodel bathrooms, and we take on kitchen updates too. Our team works in English and Spanish, which customers tell us makes the process easier for their families. We are known for working quickly and keeping prices reasonable, and we stay in touch after the job: as we told one recent client, we remain at your disposal. Our hours are Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to noon.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling for Jacksonville, FL homes
service_area.text: Latin Remodeling Llc works with homeowners in Jacksonville, FL. Whether you want a new walk-in shower, a full bathroom or a kitchen update, call (904) 767-3090 and tell us where you live and what you have in mind. If your home is outside Jacksonville, we will let you know whether we can take on the project and when we could start. Hablamos español.

items.a: Sí. Our team speaks Spanish and English. One customer says being able to talk with us in Spanish made everything so much easier for his family. Call (904) 767-3090 and speak with us in whichever language you are most comfortable using, from the first estimate to the final walkthrough.

items.q: What kind of showers do you build?
items.a: Mostly walk-in tile showers. Our photos show large marble-look porcelain walls with matte black rain heads and handhelds, and a marble shower with an iridescent blue glass hexagon accent and brushed gold fixtures. We can help you choose tile, accents and fixture finishes that fit your bathroom and budget.

Yes, kitchens are part of our work along with bathrooms. A kitchen update can cover cabinets, counters, a backsplash, flooring and paint. Call (904) 767-3090, tell us what you would like to change and how you use the room, and we will set up a visit and put together an estimate for you.

Timing depends on the size of the job, and we agree on it with you before we start. Customers describe our team as fast, and one recent client says the work was done just in time. Call us with your dates and we will tell you honestly what is realistic.

We are open Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 12 PM, and closed on Sunday. Call (904) 767-3090 during those hours to ask about a bathroom, shower or kitchen project, or to set up an estimate visit.
